title: Numeric-conservation gate: require exact dice tokens (family-match hides modifier drift)
description:
Post-merge review of PR #455 (verified against current main, 2026-07-19). Guard-quality hardening — no known wrong record in the committed pack.

## Weakness

The magic-item numeric-conservation gate (`packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts`, "magic-item numeric conservation gate") treats dice tokens as equivalent whenever their base family matches: `diceFamily` (line ~956) strips everything from the first `+`/`-`, so `1d6+5 ≈ 1d6` and `2d10-3 ≈ 2d10` in both the forward (prose→mechanics) and reverse (mechanics→prose) directions (lines ~1094-1121). A future importer regression that silently drops or invents a flat modifier stays green.

Additionally, tokens are pooled item-wide: `mechanicsTokens` merges the parent record's mechanics with every variant's mechanics into one set, so one sibling variant or unrelated effect can satisfy another occurrence's token.

## Measured blast radius (2026-07-19, committed pack)

Re-running the gate with exact-token matching produces exactly 3 family-only survivors:

- `magic-item:robe-of-useful-items` — prose `4d4` vs mechanics `4d4+12` (both directions)
- `magic-item:staff-of-striking` — prose `1d6` vs mechanics `1d6+4` (forward)

So exact-by-default is cheap: only these two records need adjudication.

## Fix direction (per review recommendation)

- Require exact normalized dice tokens by default in both directions.
- Represent intentional equivalences as narrow record+token exceptions with a rationale (mirroring the existing `FORWARD/REVERSE_NUMERIC_CONSERVATION_ACCEPTS` pattern, but scoped to the specific token, not the whole record), ideally scoped to the exact clause/variant.
- Adjudicate the two current records first: verify against the SRD source whether the `+12`/`+4` mechanics representations are correct synthesized totals (then add scoped exceptions with source-backed rationale) or importer artifacts (then fix per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md — do not weaken the expectation to match output).
- Consider scoping token pooling per-variant/per-clause so a sibling cannot satisfy another occurrence; if that is a larger change, capture what exact-token matching alone still misses.

Importer-fix-protocol applies (touches SRD audit/gate test files).

Related: sold-item `returned` payment bypass and migration-0018 oversized-stack unresolvable edge, filed from the same review.
